name: ohmyjev
description: Jev for coding agents: effort routing, output checks and GitHub reminders by default, with opt-in lockdown security gates.

enabled.title: ohmyjev on
enabled.description: Off lets every call through. /omj off and /omj on change it for one session

lockdown.title: Lockdown
lockdown.description: Block irreversible commands, writes outside the repo or holding credentials, data leaving through WebFetch or MCP, and an unverified done

allowPaths.title: Allowed write paths outside the repo
allowPaths.description: Lockdown lets writes reach these too. Separated by ; (~ and $TMPDIR expand)

policies.title: Your rules
policies.description: Rules lockdown weighs on every call, separated by ; (e.g. never touch prod; no deploys on Friday)

injectionScreen.title: Injection screen
injectionScreen.description: Warn the agent when tool output, or a file read from outside the repo, carries instructions aimed at it

githubReminders.title: GitHub reminders
githubReminders.description: Ask the agent to double-check once before a push or a gh change; retrying goes through, no prompt for you

nudges.title: Nudges
nudges.description: One-time notes: a reply that breaks your CLAUDE.md writing rules, a vague subagent brief, an agent stuck repeating one approach

trimContext.title: Trim context
trimContext.description: Cut long shell output to what the request needs, and name the one skill a request needs instead of listing them all

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact
autoCompact.description: Compact fast when the task changes, keeping the messages that still matter verbatim

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: off, effort (reasoning effort and subagent model per request) or model (also switch the main model; discards the prompt cache)

jevTools.title: Jev tools
jevTools.description: Give the agent ask_jev and find_code: judgments about files and finding code without reading it into context

browse.title: Browse tool
browse.description: Give the agent a browse tool that does a task in your Chrome. Needs uv and Chrome

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Pin Jev's calls, denies and route under the prompt, with a dim line per decision
